summary: FD_TC_208_No Travel | APPR | Cancellation D-5 | Customer Elects Not to Travel | Refund Path
title: No Travel | APPR | Cancellation D-5 | Customer Elects Not to Travel | Refund Path
description:
Customer's flight is cancelled 5 days before departure. Customer decides they no longer want to travel and requests compensation instead of rebooking. Validates DDS behaviour when travel was NOT completed � the customer never boarded any flight. Confirms that the "No Travel" path is correctly identified: the disruption is a cancellation (INVOL), the customer did not accept rebooking, and the promise itinerary stays at the 14-day mark. Since the customer did not travel, the delay is measured as the full cancellation (no arrival at all). DDS should assess eligibility based on the cancellation itself under APPR.

Prerequisites:
PNR: Single passenger (Mathieu Pelletier), 1 leg AC domestic YUL?YYZ. Original (14-day) scheduled departure: June 20, 2026 at 08:00, scheduled arrival: 10:00. Change (D-5, June 15, 2026): INVOL � AC cancels flight AC 430. No rebooking accepted by customer. Customer contacts chatbot on June 25, 2026 (D+5 after original travel date). Flight status: CANCELLED. Booking changes: INVOL cancellation only � no VOL, no SELFREACC, no rebooking. Carrier: AC only. 72hrs: Elapsed. Time limit: Within 366 days. No duplicate case. Not employee, not infant. CyberSource: Configured to return GREEN. RDS: No flags.
